letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai feels brighter, and every monsoon breeze in Ahmedabad whispers your name. I still remember the sparkle in your eyes on the day we said “I do,” and how our love has only deepened since. You are my forever cutie, the rhythm to my heart’s song, and the gentle calm in my hectic world. No matter the timezone, my thoughts race to you, and I’m counting down to our next sweet reunion. All my love, today and always.
poem:
Across the dunes or by the river’s gleam,  
Your smile lights up my every dream.  
In every season, near or far,  
You’re my forever, my shining star.
